title: Build the Splash screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Splash/Splash.jsx. URL: ROUTES.SPLASH (/). Wireframe: 1 Splash. App logo + loader while we check if the user is logged in, then redirect.

title: Build the Onboarding screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Onboarding/Onboarding.jsx. URL: ROUTES.ONBOARDING (/welcome). Wireframe: 2 Onboarding. 2-3 intro slides explaining 3D tours, then Sign up / Log in buttons.

title: Build the Signup screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Signup/Signup.jsx. URL: ROUTES.SIGNUP (/signup). Wireframe: 3 Sign Up / Role. Sign-up form + role picker (buyer, seller). Calls AUTH.SIGNUP, then goes to OTP.

title: Build the Login screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Login/Login.jsx. URL: ROUTES.LOGIN (/login). Wireframe: 3 Sign Up / Role. Email + password. Calls AUTH.LOGIN, stores token, goes to Home.

title: Build the Otp screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Otp/Otp.jsx. URL: ROUTES.OTP (/verify). Wireframe: 3 Sign Up / Role. 6-digit OTP input + resend timer. Calls AUTH.VERIFY_OTP / AUTH.RESEND_OTP.

title: Build the Home screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Home/Home.jsx. URL: ROUTES.HOME (/home). Wireframe: 4 Home. Featured listings, quick search bar, buy / rent / short-stay tabs.

title: Build the Search screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Search/Search.jsx. URL: ROUTES.SEARCH (/search). Wireframe: 5 Search + Filters. Filters (type, price, district) + results list + Leaflet map. Calls LISTINGS.LIST.

title: Build the Listing screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Listing/Listing.jsx. URL: ROUTES.LISTING (/listings/:id). Wireframe: 6 Listing. Photos, price, details, 'Open 3D tour', 'Book viewing', 'Chat with seller'.

title: Build the Tour screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Tour/Tour.jsx. URL: ROUTES.TOUR (/listings/:id/tour). Wireframe: 6-7 3D Tour + Measure. Full-screen 3D viewer of the LiDAR scan + measure tool.

title: Build the Compare screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Compare/Compare.jsx. URL: ROUTES.COMPARE (/compare). Wireframe: 8 Compare. Side-by-side table of 2-3 listings. Calls LISTINGS.COMPARE.

title: Build the Booking screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Booking/Booking.jsx. URL: ROUTES.BOOKING (/listings/:id/book). Wireframe: 9 Book / Request Viewing. Pick a date for a viewing or a short stay. Calls BOOKINGS.CREATE.

title: Build the Chat screen
body: File: client/src/pages/Chat/Chat.jsx. URL: ROUTES.CHAT (/chat). Wireframe: 10 Chat. Conversation list + message thread. REST for history, Socket.IO for live messages.

title: Build the ScanRequest screen
body: File: client/src/pages/ScanRequest/ScanRequest.jsx. URL: ROUTES.SCAN_REQUEST (/sell/scan-request). Wireframe: 11 Seller Scan Request. Seller asks our team to come and LiDAR-scan the property. Calls SCANS.CREATE.

title: Build the AdminDashboard screen
body: File: client/src/pages/AdminDashboard/AdminDashboard.jsx. URL: ROUTES.ADMIN (/admin). Wireframe: 12 Admin Dashboard. Stats, scan-request queue, upload finished 3D tours. Admin only.

title: Build the NotFound screen
body: File: client/src/pages/NotFound/NotFound.jsx. URL: ROUTES.NOT_FOUND (*). Wireframe: -. 404 page with a link back home.

title: Build the AUTH API
body: Folder: server/src/modules/auth/. Endpoints: POST /api/auth/signup; POST /api/auth/verify-otp; POST /api/auth/resend-otp; POST /api/auth/login; GET /api/auth/me. Contract: docs/API.md -> AUTH.

title: Build the LISTINGS API
body: Folder: server/src/modules/listings/. Endpoints: GET /api/listings; GET /api/listings/compare; GET /api/listings/:id; POST /api/listings; PATCH /api/listings/:id. Contract: docs/API.md -> LISTINGS.

title: Build the SCANS API
body: Folder: server/src/modules/scans/. Endpoints: POST /api/scan-requests; GET /api/scan-requests/mine; PATCH /api/scan-requests/:id/status; POST /api/scan-requests/:id/tour. Contract: docs/API.md -> SCANS.

title: Build the BOOKINGS API
body: Folder: server/src/modules/bookings/. Endpoints: POST /api/bookings; GET /api/bookings/mine; PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status. Contract: docs/API.md -> BOOKINGS.

title: Build the CHAT API
body: Folder: server/src/modules/chat/. Endpoints: GET /api/chat/conversations; POST /api/chat/conversations; GET /api/chat/conversations/:id/messages. Contract: docs/API.md -> CHAT.

title: Build the ADMIN API
body: Folder: server/src/modules/admin/. Endpoints: GET /api/admin/stats; GET /api/admin/scan-requests; GET /api/admin/users. Contract: docs/API.md -> ADMIN.

title: Build shared components (Button, Input, Loader, Navbar)
body: Folder: client/src/components/ and client/src/styles/index.css. Do this first: every other screen uses them. Match the wireframe colours and add them as @theme tokens.

title: Test the 3D scan pipeline end to end
body: Scan one room on the iPhone, export .glb, load it in a test page with three.js. Decide the export app and file size limit, write the steps in docs/.

title: Build JWT auth middleware
body: File: server/src/middleware/auth.js. requireAuth must verify the token and set req.user = { id, role }. M5 is blocked on this, so do it right after login works.

title: Add login state and protected pages
body: Files: client/src/hooks/useAuth.jsx (AuthProvider + useAuth) and client/src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx. Keeps the logged in user, sends logged out users to ROUTES.LOGIN, blocks non admins from ROUTES.ADMIN.

title: Write the setup guide
body: File: docs/SETUP.md. Step by step install for Windows, Mac and Linux: Node 22, Git, PostgreSQL, clone, .env files, migrate, run. Test it on a teammate's laptop.

title: Write the database document
body: File: docs/DATABASE.md. Every table and column in plain words plus an ER diagram (dbdiagram.io or draw.io, export PNG to docs/images/). Get changes from Purshottam.

title: Write the testing document
body: File: docs/TESTING.md. Table of test cases for every screen and endpoint: ID, steps, expected, actual, pass/fail, tester, date.

title: Start the meeting notes and progress log
body: Folder: docs/meetings/ (one file per meeting, YYYY-MM-DD.md) and docs/PROGRESS.md (one short entry per week: done, next, blockers).

title: Write the user manual
body: File: docs/USER-MANUAL.md with screenshots in docs/images/. How a buyer, a seller and an admin use every screen.

title: Build listing photo upload
body: Endpoint: POST /api/listings/:id/images (API.LISTINGS.UPLOAD_IMAGES). Use multer, save to server/uploads/listings/, store URLs in listing_images. Contract: docs/API.md -> LISTINGS.

title: Write sample data for testing
body: File: server/db/seed.js plus npm script db:seed. 1 admin, 3 sellers, 3 buyers, 15 listings across DISTRICTS, some scan requests, bookings and messages. Everyone uses this to test.
